state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages; lessons follow the real grade-2 textbooks (the game is the child's homework; textbook text verbatim). Parties of 2-4 (players or labelled bots) exist; a co-op mode with shared challenges and team bosses is being built.
state.owner_request: Every quest should be playable in co-op, including the zone guardian bosses.
state.quest_step_kinds: dialogue, search/find-object (find things on the map), read, speak, worksheet, decision, logic and other challenges, riddle, boss (multi-turn questions with HP), reward, next.
state.rules: Rewards are server-computed per player, once per run, replays pay; nothing is locked; every quest stays playable solo; no competitive individual scores.

learning_steps_in_coop.instructions: When a party plays any quest together, how are learning steps (questions, challenges, riddles) handled?

criteria.each_answers_own: Exploration steps are shared (anyone finding an item, talking or reading moves the party on); every question/challenge step is answered by each member on her own screen, and the party moves on when all have answered (friends can cheer and send hint emotes, never the answer); bosses are team bosses with shared HP where each member answers her own turns.
criteria.take_turns: Members take turns: each question goes to one member, the others watch and cheer; everyone gets the step.
criteria.anyone_answers: Whoever answers first completes the step for everyone.

progress_ownership.instructions: Whose quest progress moves in co-op?

criteria.each_own_progress: Each member's own progress on that quest moves (the leader picks the quest; a member who already finished it plays a replay run).
criteria.leader_only: Only the leader's progress moves; others just help.
